template: In {context}, debugging is primarily used to isolate the root cause of a crash or unexpected behavior, allowing developers to move from 'it doesn't work' to 'I know exactly why it fails'.

fallback: Debugging is a great way to learn because it shows you the internal state of a program as it executes.

template: To improve {context}, we use profiling and debugging to identify 'bottlenecks'—those specific lines of code that are consuming the most CPU or memory.
fallback: Debugging helps identify performance lags by pinpointing inefficient loops or memory leaks.

template: For {context}, debugging involves inspecting the request and response payloads to ensure the data format matches what the server expects.
